interfaces.name: Update availability check (POSIX and Windows)
symbols: check-update.sh SKILLS=(nine-router-setup spec-protocol kaizen eli5 bro) L48

measured.local_version_source: <skill>/VERSION; a missing or non-version file yields UNDETERMINED exit 2
measured.local_version_gate_exact: check-update.sh check_one_skill() L129 reads $LOCAL_SKILLS_ROOT/<skill>/VERSION by an EXACT-CASE path lookup with no fallback (local_file assigned at L131, missing-file refusal at L137-140), then requires the content to pass is_version() L77-88 (digits and dots only, no leading/trailing dot, no '..', <=32 chars). A missing file, an empty file, or content is_version() rejects all yield UNDETERMINED exit 2 — the skill cannot report an update at all. skill-version.txt is never read by the gate.

update_capability_under_the_gate.instrument: the gate above, applied to the committed tree; every figure in this object comes from that one instrument

version_file_present_but_content_rejecte: drama-song-ad-factory (VERSION holds 'v2.9.103'; is_version() rejects the leading 'v'; its skill-version.txt holds the same rejected string)
version_file_spelled_other_than_exact_VE: council-of-wise-elders (root entry 'version', lowercase, holding 1.0.55; the gate's lookup is case-sensitive)

update_capability_under_the_gate.host_note: On a case-INsensitive filesystem (macOS APFS default) the lowercase 'version' is found and council-of-wise-elders can report: 10 can / 5 cannot. On a case-SENSITIVE filesystem (Linux VPS and Docker, the hosts GAP-13 names) it is invisible: 9 can / 6 cannot. The gate's literal contract is the case-sensitive one. Presence is not usability: 10 registered skills carry a file named exactly VERSION and only 9 of those can report, and 4 more carry a usable version number in a file the gate never opens.

measured.version_file_presence_instrument: skill_dirs_with_VERSION counts every skill dir holding SKILL.md that has an exact-case root entry named VERSION; registered_skills_without_VERSION counts registry entries with no such entry. Both figures are from that one case-sensitive instrument and the second is 15 minus the 10 registered skills among them. File presence only — see update_capability_under_the_gate for what the gate can actually do with those files. The first draft of this artifact quoted skill_dirs_with_VERSION from this instrument and registered_skills_without_VERSION from a case-INsensitive one (which gives 11 and 4); the two cannot both hold.
